tabs.html:
VSOL GPON PON SFP Module 2.5G C++++ 9dBm | High-Speed Optical Transceiver for Fiber Networks


The VSOL GPON PON SFP Module 2.5G C++++ 9dBm is a cutting-edge optical transceiver designed to deliver high-speed data transmission and superior performance for GPON networks. With a robust +9dBm optical output power, this 2.5G SFP module is perfect for service providers, telecom companies, and enterprises looking to expand or upgrade their fiber optic network infrastructure.


Key Features:

  • 2.5G GPON SFP Module: This Gigabit Passive Optical Network (GPON) module supports 2.5 Gbps downstream speed, ensuring smooth and fast internet connections for end-users in fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) or fiber optic broadband networks.
  • +9dBm Optical Power: With an output power of +9dBm, the module offers reliable long-distance transmission over single-mode fiber (SMF), minimizing signal loss and enhancing overall fiber optic network performance.
  • Hot-Swappable SFP Form Factor: The Small Form-factor Pluggable (SFP) design enables easy installation, hot-swapping, and maintenance-free operation, making it an ideal choice for network upgrades and expansions.
  • Wide Compatibility: Fully compatible with GPON Optical Line Terminals (OLTs) and Optical Network Units (ONUs), this SFP module ensures seamless integration into existing GPON infrastructure.
  • Cost-Effective Solution for GPON Networks: Offering a high-performance solution at a competitive price, this VSOL SFP module is ideal for budget-conscious telecom operators and network engineers.
  • Durable and Reliable: Engineered for high durability, the VSOL GPON PON SFP module is designed to perform reliably in a variety of environmental conditions, ensuring consistent optical signal transmission for years to come.


Applications:

  • Telecom Providers & Internet Service Providers (ISPs): Perfect for expanding high-speed fiber-optic GPON network solutions.
  • Fiber-to-the-Home (FTTH) Networks: Ideal for connecting homes and businesses with high-speed fiber broadband.
  • Business & Enterprise Fiber Networks: A reliable choice for businesses seeking to upgrade or deploy fiber optic connections for better performance.


Why Choose the VSOL GPON PON SFP Module 2.5G 9dBm?

The VSOL 2.5G GPON PON SFP Module offers exceptional value for anyone looking to enhance the performance of their fiber optic network. With advanced features like hot-swappability, high optical power, and compatibility with GPON equipment, it is a versatile solution for telecom networks, FTTH deployments, and fiber broadband infrastructure.
